news.title: Expanding What It Means to Educate
news.summary_en: A person’s growth is shaped by many people along the way. A educator who sparks curiosity. A counselor who helps navigate a difficult moment. A coach who builds confidence and resilience. A mentor who helps someone discover a sense of purpose. A student affairs professional who creates a sense of belonging during a time of transition.  Different roles.…
news.author: Katie Palmer Wharton '14

news.title: Butler University Announces New Master’s Entry-to-Practice Nursing Program
news.summary_en: Designed for individuals with non-nursing bachelor’s degrees, the MSN-ETP program offers an accelerated, graduate-level pathway into nursing while helping address growing healthcare workforce needs.
